title: PP&E costs, depreciation & capitalized interest — Ridgeway Foods
instructions: Ridgeway Foods (calendar year-end) is expanding. Classify the costs, compute depreciation on a new machine, and compute capitalized interest on its new plant. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Costs incurred
exhibits.content:
1. Purchase price of land for a new plant, including an old barn: **$600,000**
2. Cost to demolish the barn: **$18,000**
3. Paving of the employee parking lot: **$75,000**
4. Architect fees for the plant: **$95,000**
5. Annual property taxes on the land for the year after purchase: **$9,000**
6. Freight to deliver a packaging machine: **$4,000**
7. Training employees to use the machine: **$7,000**

exhibits.title: Packaging machine
exhibits.content: Placed in service **July 1, Year 1**. Invoice price **$150,000**; freight **$4,000**; installation and testing **$6,000**. Estimated salvage **$16,000**; useful life **6 years**. Ridgeway takes a half year of depreciation in the year of acquisition (the machine was in service exactly six months).

exhibits.title: Plant construction (Year 1)
exhibits.content:
Expenditures: **$900,000** on Feb 1; **$600,000** on Jun 1; **$300,000** on Nov 1. Construction continues into Year 2.

Debt outstanding all year: **$1,000,000** construction loan at **6%**; other general debt **$3,000,000** at **8%**.

rows.label: 1. Land and barn purchase price
rows.explanation: The barn will be razed, so the whole price is land.

rows.label: 2. Demolishing the barn
rows.explanation: Preparing newly acquired land for its intended use.

rows.label: 3. Parking lot paving
rows.explanation: Limited-life improvement — depreciable, separate from land.

rows.label: 4. Architect fees
rows.explanation: Necessary cost of constructing the plant.

rows.label: 5. Property taxes after purchase
rows.explanation: Ongoing carrying cost, not an acquisition cost.

rows.label: 6. Machine freight
rows.explanation: Cost of bringing the machine to its location.

rows.label: 7. Employee training
rows.explanation: Training is not necessary to make the machine ready for use.

rows.label: Year 1 depreciation — double-declining balance
rows.explanation: Rate 2/6 = 33.33%. First depreciation year 160,000 × 1/3 = 53,333; half in Year 1 = **26,667**.

rows.label: Year 2 depreciation — double-declining balance
rows.explanation: Second half of depreciation year 1 (26,667) + first half of depreciation year 2 ((160,000 − 53,333) × 1/3 = 35,556 × ½ = 17,778) = **44,444**.

parts.prompt: Interest capitalized on the plant in Year 1.
